Name: Adspy
Hero - Description: Find Meta and TikTok ads in your niche. Compare creatives, offers and running time to choose the angles to test for your store.
Use case - Title: Why use an adspy tool for your store?
Use case - Description: Before paying for a new creative, look at what brands in your market are advertising. An adspy tool connects the product, offer and advertising message. Build a list of ideas to test from concrete examples, while remembering that a visible ad is not proof of a profitable campaign.
Card 1 - Description - Use Case: Search for a brand or keyword to see featured products, promotions and selling points. Compare several ads before choosing an angle.
Card 2 - Title - Use Case: Find angles for your next tests
Card 2 - Description - Use Case: Break down the opening hook, product demonstration and offer. Use the problem being solved as inspiration for an ad that fits your audience and brand.
Card 3 - Description - Use Case: Compare running time and engagement with the available data. An ad that has been active for a long time deserves a closer look, but does not prove profitability.
Feature - Description: Copyfy brings ad search, filters and saved ads into one interface. Narrow a broad search into useful examples, then compare formats, launch dates and available data. Meta reach and spend data cover ads shown in the European Union; they do not reveal a competitor’s profit.
Card 1 - Description - Feature: Filter by country, platform, format, date and engagement. Review ads relevant to your market instead of scrolling through unrelated campaigns.
Card 2 - Description - Feature: Describe a product, niche or angle to find relevant examples. Use the results to prepare your creative brief.
Card 3 - Description - Feature: Check whether an ad is active and how long it has been running. Distinguish recent launches from creatives shown over a longer period.
Card 4 - Description - Feature: Analyze available reach and spend for Meta ads in the European Union. Compare the signals without inferring ROAS or sales that are not shown.
Card 5 - Description - Feature: Compare new ads with those that remain active. Consider the product, season and offer before deciding what to test.
Card 6 - Description - Feature: Save useful ads and download available visuals to organize your research. Build a reference for your team, then produce your own creatives.
Meta Description: Copyfy adspy: find competitor ads on Meta and TikTok, compare creatives and delivery signals, and plan your next advertising tests.
Meta Title: Adspy: analyze your competitors’ ads | Copyfy
